module.name: AWS CNE Controller IRSA
module.description: IRSA + IAM policy for the F5 CNE controller's ServiceAccount, so it can attach BNK Gateway VIPs and F5SPKVlan selfips as secondary IPs on dedicated SR-IOV / host-device ENIs (per F5 Doc 3 Multi-AZ Network Architecture). Required when bnk/cneinstance.tmm_data_plane_mode = "kernel".

required.reason: Need cluster name + OIDC provider ARN/URL
FLO creates the CNE controller ServiceAccount during CNEInstance reconciliation; this module annotates it

required.name: oidc_provider_arn
required.description: ARN of the cluster's IAM OIDC provider

required.name: oidc_provider_url
required.description: URL of the cluster's IAM OIDC provider

optional.name: cne_controller_namespace
optional.description: Namespace where the CNE controller runs

optional.name: cne_controller_sa_name
optional.description: ServiceAccount name of the CNE controller (FLO derives from CNEInstance: f5-cne-controller-<instance>-f5-cne-controller-serviceaccount)

optional.name: cne_controller_deployment_name
optional.description: Deployment name of the CNE controller (used for rollout-restart)

optional.name: extra_managed_policy_arns
optional.description: Optional additional managed policies to attach to the role

optional.name: wait_for_sa_timeout_seconds
optional.description: How long to wait for FLO to create the SA before giving up

optional.name: cneinstance_ready
optional.description: Gate from bnk/cneinstance to ensure the SA exists before annotation

key_outputs.name: role_arn
key_outputs.description: ARN of the IAM role bound to the CNE controller SA

key_outputs.name: policy_arn
key_outputs.description: ARN of the allow-ec2-vip IAM policy

key_outputs.name: annotated_serviceaccount
key_outputs.description: Namespaced name of the SA that was annotated

key_outputs.name: ready
key_outputs.description: Set after the SA is annotated and controller restarted
